description: Edit prose for clarity and concision. Use when the user asks to tighten, simplify or proofread text.

# Clear writing

When editing the user's text:

1. Keep the author's meaning and voice; never add claims.
2. Put the main point in the first sentence of each paragraph.
3. Prefer concrete verbs over nominalisations ("decide" not "make a decision").
4. Cut filler: "very", "really", "in order to", "it is important to note that".
5. Split sentences longer than about 30 words.
6. Use active voice unless the actor is unknown or irrelevant.
7. Keep terminology consistent; do not alternate synonyms for the same concept.

Return the edited text first, then a short bullet list of the most important changes.
